_note: v2 hook overrides for la plage (B29_plage). Source hooks are kept wherever the painting can show them; these replace only hooks whose setting does not fit the beach or that differ from what is painted.

fr_ocean_noun.why: The breaching whale is already the hook for la baleine; the painting shows the girl gasping at a giant ocean wave instead.

fr_flot_noun.why: Source says 'down the river'; there is no river on the beach, so the ducks bob down a beach stream.

fr_vase_noun_f.why: Source sets it in a pond; on the beach it sits in tidal mud.

fr_maree_noun.why: The painting shows Marie beside her sandcastle with the sea coming in, not the wave already washing over it. Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ma-RAY -> mah-RAY).

fr_cap_noun.why: No sailor is painted on the headland; the lighthouse on the cape carries both meanings.

fr_plongeur_noun.why: Source says into a pool; here he dives from a springboard into the sea.

fr_derive_noun.why: The centreboard is not visible in the painting, so it is left out of the hook.

fr_oasis_noun.why: Owner review 2026-10-25 (lesson 2): no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal is the hook; the rabbit no longer holds a cup; it drinks like a plain rabbit.

fr_parasol_noun.why: The painting shows a boy under the parasol with the sunglassed sun beside it rather than the sun itself underneath.

fr_surf_noun.why: The painted surfer is a boy, not a dog.

fr_dune_noun.why: Owner review 2026-10-25 (lesson 2): no anthropomorphic animals unless the animal is the hook; the camel on the surfboard was repainted as a girl.

fr_littoral_noun.why: Paint-back (sparse rule): plan-only since p16 (from camping/souche); painted into plage/cap, which had dropped to 4 words.

fr_peignoir_noun.why: Paint-back (sparse rule): taken out of plage/cap in p20 (planned R_bathroom, plan-only); painted back in the bathing cabin, cap 5 -> 6.

fr_baleine_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (ba-LEN -> bah-LEHN).

fr_mer_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: bracketed respelling matched to the card (MAIR -> MEHR).

fr_debarquer_verb.why: day-BARK-ay → débarquer = to get off a boat, to land, to disembark. Regular -er: RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_campeur/st_campeur into plage/plage; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_sombrer_verb.why: Somber = dark → sombrer = to sink, to founder. Regular -er: RED beret. Wave 1 oct29: moved from st_riviere/st_riviere into plage/plage; hook rewritten to match the new painting.
ex: Son petit bateau sombre dans la flaque.
His little boat sinks in the pool.

fr_chavirer_verb.why: SHAVE + a capsizing boat → chavirer = to capsize, to tip over. Regular -er: RED beret. Wave 1b oct30: moved from st_marees/chavires into plage/plage; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_atterrir_verb.why: a-tear-REAR: he lands on his rear → atterrir = to land, to touch down. Regular -ir: GREEN beret. Wave 1b oct30: moved from st_campeur/st_campeur into plage/dunes; hook rewritten to match the new painting.

fr_pizza_noun.why: The source respelling used a syllable that reads as pee. Painted in the beach hut picnic.

fr_epice_noun.why: The source respelling used a syllable that reads as pee. Painted in the beach hut picnic.

fr_cereale_noun.why: The picnic shows the cereal in a bowl with a spoon.

fr_vinaigre_noun.why: The hut shows a cruet beside the green salad, not a drink.
